# ShapedOps

> ShapedOps is a CRM and business operations platform built for manufacturers, foundries, and trading businesses in India. It replaces Excel, WhatsApp, and manual/paper tracking with one system for order and dispatch tracking, automatic client updates, and document generation.

## About

ShapedOps is currently in early access, opening to a small first cohort of manufacturing and trading businesses on a first-come basis. It is built and operated by Ashlyticss (https://www.ashlyticss.com), a data analytics agency based in Ahmedabad, India.

## Who it's for

Manufacturers, foundries, machine shops, fabricators, and trading/export businesses — primarily based in Gujarat and across India.

## Key features

- Automated order and dispatch pipeline tracking, from first contact to closed
- WhatsApp-based automated client updates as orders move through stages
- Payment and milestone tracking
- Automatic document generation (dispatch notes, client documents)
- Real-time business metrics (revenue, pipeline value, conversion)
- Workflow shaped around the business's existing process rather than a fixed template

## Pricing

Custom, based on business requirements. No published self-serve pricing during early access.
